title: Cost invariance under relabeling
statement: For any types $\alpha$ and $\beta$, any CNF formula $\varphi$ over $\alpha$, and any map $f: \alpha \to \beta$, relabeling the variables by $f$ preserves the cost: $\operatorname{cost}(\varphi\text{ relabeled by }f)=\operatorname{cost}(\varphi)$.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF formula over an arbitrary type $\alpha$
A map $f: \alpha \to \beta$ to an arbitrary type $\beta$
